Main.dc.html.title: Social encounter v1a · zoom to the hex: Lady and party tokens on the board, dialogue panel along the bottom. Lines, coins, heads needed and who is proficient are placeholders

Social-v1b-DimmedCard.dc.html.title: Social encounter v1b · a cream card over the dimmed world (like after-combat): big NPC portrait hex, lines and options beside it

Social-v1c-FaceToFace.dc.html.title: Social encounter v1c · face to face: NPC and hero portrait hexes, speech bubbles between them, options as pills along the bottom

Social-v1d-OptionCards.dc.html.title: Social encounter v1d · options as cards: the NPC's line on top, reply options dealt like hotbar cards with an approach band

Social-v2a-PlayerPicks.dc.html.title: Social encounter v2a · v1d layout with the Lady's real lines (tap to page). Non-social checks: the player picks who flips in the pop-up. Party scores, proficiencies, heads needed and bonus sizes are placeholders

Social-v2b-AlwaysHero.dc.html.title: Social encounter v2b · the same, but the hero always flips

Social-v2c-AutoPick.dc.html.title: Social encounter v2c · the same, but auto-pick: highest score for the check flips, the hero on ties

Social-v3b-Toast.dc.html.title: Social encounter v3b · the same, with rewards as a toast above the cards that fades

Social-v3c-IconRow.dc.html.title: Social encounter v3c · the same, with one icon hex per result beside the line's panel (tap for details)
